def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k == 0 or n <= 1:
        return [0] * n

    vals = sorted(set(a), reverse=True)
    m = len(vals)
    if m == 1:
        return [0] * n

    rank = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(vals, 1)}
    ranks = [rank[x] for x in a]

    bit = [0] * (m + 1)
    res = [0] * n

    for i, r in enumerate(ranks):
        s = 0
        j = r - 1
        while j > 0:
            s += bit[j]
            j &= j - 1
        res[i] = s

        j = r
        while j <= m:
            bit[j] += 1
            j += j & -j

        if i >= k:
            j = ranks[i - k]
            while j <= m:
                bit[j] -= 1
                j += j & -j

    return res
